messages:
Ana: quick design question: for the change-diff cards in the rollout UI, should we return presigned proof URLs for full actor detail or perform inline actor lookups? tradeoffs: perf, quotas, PII.
Tyler: presigned URLs. keeps the console from needing identity-db calls and lets downloads decrement export quota only when used. also easier for private deploys where we can't expose identity service.
Kris: presigned is good for heavy downloads, but for small inline displays (name + role) an extra redirect + S3 fetch feels heavy. could we return a tiny "actor stub" (id, display_name, role) and only presigned for the full proof blob?
Marta: +1 for stub + presigned. UX: show stub immediately, lazy-load full proof on click via presigned. If presigned denied (quota), surface CTA: "Request audit export".
Leo: telemetry/ops constraints: if we return stubs from main /audit/events endpoint we need to ensure the actor-stub lookup is cheap. Propose: embed stub in event stream where available, otherwise client should call /audit/hints. Instrument: `audit.stub.cache_hit`, `audit.presign.request_count`, `audit.presign.denied_quota`.
Tyler: infra note: presigned URLs should be short-lived (1m) and one-time-use if possible. For CDN caching of full proofs we need signed uploads to a readonly bucket; consider signed URLs with nonce+ETag verification to prevent replay.
Kris: API sketch for stub + presign response:
```json
{
  "event_id": "E:987",
  "actor_stub": {"actor_id":"A:123","display_name":"Sam W","role":"owner"},
  "proof_presign": null // filled when client requests full proof
}
```
Client GET /audit/events -> gets stubs. Client GET /audit/events/E:987/proof -> returns presign or 403 if quota exhausted.
Marta: UX error states: 1) masked stub when tenant has export disabled; 2) spinner + fallback text if presign times out; 3) inline tooltip explaining why details are redacted. Keep messages short, avoid modal popups for presign failures.
Leo: quotas: two buckets. `audit.inline_lookups` (high RPS, cheap) and `audit.presign_exports` (low RPS, quota-controlled). Also add per-route epsilon quota for prefetching to avoid N+1 storms (i.e., debounce client prefetch to 200ms).
Ana: about caching: can we cache stubs at CDN edge for 30s? many users click around quickly. TTL low enough to keep freshness but high enough to cut DB load.
Tyler: 30s TTL OK for stubs. For proofs, don't cache sensitive blobs; only cache presign responses (the URL) for a few seconds to help retry storms.
Kris: security check: make sure presign endpoint validates tenant and caller entitlements server-side. No client-side gating. Also log presign attempts with actor_id hash to avoid storing PII in logs.
Leo: telemetry fields to add: `route_id`, `tenant_id_hash`, `actor_stub_served`, `presign_latency_ms`, `presign_denied_reason`. We'll add these to the audit pipeline.
Marta: one more thing: batch presign API for list of event_ids to support bulk download from the export modal. Endpoint: POST /audit/presign-batch with list of ids -> returns map of id->url or id->error. Rate-limited separately.
Ana: summary/action items: Tyler implement presign service + TTL rules, Kris update API contract with actor_stub schema + batch presign, Leo add telemetry + quota buckets, Marta write console UX copy for redaction/failure states. Aim: prototyped in staging by EOD Fri, canary to 10% next week.
Audit-bot: Created ticket ENG-8433 (audit-presign-stub-work) and assigned to tyler.
